audit.why: EVEN 5.5/10 fits a squishy no-dash enabler who wins the lane if Leona can't burst him before Chronoshift comes online.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0-6].side all read 'Skill' while content win[0-6] reads Skill/Leona/Leona/Leona/Leona/Leona/Zilean — rows 1-6 disagree between the two layers, and the phase whys are the generic Skill template that never explains Zilean's late-game flip.
audit.why: Leona has no dash to lose to (Zilean lacks one), so E-Q converts freely from level 2 through first item; late, Chronoshift (R, 120/90/60s cd) revives the carry through her all-in and Rewind-refreshed E slows peel her dive — matching content's Zilean-favoured row 6 and Leona-favoured rows 1-5.
audit.corrected: Move phases[1-6].side to match win[1-6] (Leona for 1-5, Zilean for 6) and rewrite each .why from the kit; row 0 already agrees (Skill/Skill), left alone.

audit.why: Chronoshift's revive-through-lethal and the fact Zilean has no dash to escape Zenith Blade are already documented in the content layer's spikes and wants.

edits.before: E-Q online — the chain is live and the lane's geometry answers to your blade.
edits.after: Your level-2 E-Q chain locks him before he can double-bomb — Rewind-refreshed Q is his only reset.

edits.before: Full chain: E-Q-W locks a carry for the full duo rotation; pick the window.
edits.after: He still has no dash to escape your gap-close at 3, so every clean E-Q converts.

edits.before: Zone with chain threat — their carry farms where your E says.
edits.after: Your tankiness lets you walk through his Q bomb and dive freely at 4-5.

edits.before: Solar Flare online — dives start from two screens and the sun votes center-stun.
edits.after: Solar Flare bursts him before Chronoshift (R, 120s at rank 1) can turn the fight.

edits.before: First item: the chain hardens and every landed E is a kill.
edits.after: First-item tankiness lets you ignore his poke and reach his carry directly.

edits.before: Late Leona starts everything: flare the entry, chain the carry, eclipse the answer.
edits.after: With Chronoshift and E haste online, his revive and refreshed slows undo your engage in extended fights.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Zilean has no dash — every clean E-Q before his revive is online just converts, no reset possible.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with armor.
edits.after: Chronoshift (R) makes him untargetable through lethal damage — don't dump your whole combo waiting it out, force it early instead.

edits.before: - Zilean Chronoshift: matchup-defining — The revive undoes your kill — force it early or swap focus when it glows. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your W Eclipse answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: - Zilean's R (Chronoshift) resets in 120s at rank 1, 60s at rank 3 — force it early or swap focus once it glows. - Rewind (W) shortens his other cooldowns as it ranks, so his Q returns faster late. - Spend your own R on swing moments only.
